title: Reviewed Costco recommendation batch
description: Paste into the visible recommendation editor. Preview first; registration saves draft facts only. Dates and JPY facts are per item and never inferred from an issue. Date pairs and original/offer price order are also checked by the editor/server.

itemNumber.description: String preserves leading zeros; never supply a JSON number. Omit/null when source omits it.

currency.description: All amounts are JPY; no conversion or inventory repricing.

referencePrice.description: Offer price, or the sole stated price; omit if absent.

discountAmount.description: Only the stated JPY reduction; do not calculate a missing price.

priceUnit.description: E.g. 100g, pack, bottle. Applies to this row's amounts.

couponStart.description: Coupon issue start; separate from redemption.

couponEnd.description: Coupon issue end; separate from redemption.

imageUrl.description: Official Costco static PNG/JPEG. Normal visible UI fetches, validates and stores it.

fileName.description: Exact name of a PNG/JPEG already selected in the visible file picker. Each file must be nonempty and at most 8 MiB.
